turns.assessment: The direct optical evidence indicates a simultaneous bidirectional loss on both cable routes adjacent to S20: the first spans from S20 toward S01 and S13 have OSC loss and the following inline amplifiers report input LOS, while the reverse fibres show OSC/preamp loss at the S20 end. Stable pump currents argue against amplifier pump failures, and OSC loss on multiple degrees rules out a single ROADM WSS-port failure. This is most consistent with excavation or similar common-duct damage cutting both cables, but the required location model cannot identify that multi-span event as one repairable element, so neither individual span is an 80% complete cause.

proposals.rationale: O107 reports OSC loss on this first span from S20, O1 reports input LOS at the immediately downstream amplifier, and O105/O103 corroborate loss of the reverse fibre at the S20 end. This establishes a bidirectional cable cut on the S20–S01 route, but it does not alone explain the simultaneous S20–S13 loss.
